name: zen-foil
summary: One <zen-foil> element = one live engraved-hologram plate (WebGPU, WebGL2 fallback, CSS poster without a GPU). Load dist/zen-foil.js once as a module, then write tags. Every option is a plain HTML attribute.
rules: Load zen-foil.js exactly once, from one URL, as <script type="module">. Pin the CDN to a commit (@<sha>), not @main.
Use only scene ids and attributes listed here. Anything else is ignored, so check with ZenFoil.check() or scripts/verify.mjs.
Points are "lon,lat; lon,lat" with longitude first (Washington, D.C. is -77.04,38.91).
Engraved text is short, UPPERCASE and true. Never invent figures, partners or credentials: leave the attribute out instead.
Brand params default to ZEN AI Co. copy. For any other brand set every brandParams entry, or remove ZEN marks with mark="none" where allowed.
One hero plate per viewport, at most ~8 plates on screen, field backgrounds at low density (0.15–0.3).
Real headings and copy stay in the DOM next to the plate (SEO, accessibility); the plate is the visual.
The plate's height comes from the scene's aspect ratio unless your CSS sets a height; give it a width (it is display:block, full width).

scene.description: Required. Which scene to draw (see scenes).

accent.description: Any CSS colour: #hex, rgb(), hsl(var(--primary)), oklch(). One per plate, from the brand.

theme.description: plate (dark, default), paper (light security paper) or clear (ink only, over your own background). Ignored by raw/alpha scenes.

aria-label.description: Accessible name. Without it the plate is decorative.

max-dpr.description: Device-pixel-ratio ceiling (1–3). Use 1.25–1.5 for big background layers.

class.description: CSS classes. On the raw element in React 18 write class, not className.

style.description: Inline CSS. The height comes from the scene's aspect unless CSS sets one.

events.foil-fail: No GPU or the scene failed to compile: the CSS poster stays (detail.reason).
events.foil-error: A problem with an image, mark or param (detail.message).

methods.replay(): Plays the minting intro again (burin, foil, press).
methods.ZenFoil.check(): Checks every plate on the page; returns problems with exact fixes.
methods.ZenFoil.describe(id?): This contract, or one scene's entry.
methods.ZenFoil.snippet(id, params, opts?): A valid tag for a scene, or an error saying what to fix.

glyphs: ASCII, ·•→←±×∷∵∴⊕⊗※÷≈≡∞△◇◈✦αλΣΩπ∇∂ and アイウエオカ. Accents fold to the base letter, — prints as -, anything else as ·.

scenes.title: Security seal
scenes.description: Guilloche medallion around a brand mark, ring microprint, a stamping pulse and a live credential serial.

mark.description: Brand mark: zen, bgc, near, a registered name, SVG path data or an image URL.

layout.description: Medallion position; auto stacks on narrow plates.

counter.description: Append a live 6-digit counter to the serial.

micro.default: ZEN AI CO · AUTHENTIC · ORDO AB CHAO ·
micro.description: Microprint around the ring and along the edges.

serial.description: Credential serial (prefix, when counter is on).

scenes.example:
<zen-foil scene="seal" mark="zen" headline="ZEN AI CO" subline="ISSUED UNDER SEAL"
  serial="ZEN-2026-"></zen-foil>
scenes.template:
<zen-foil scene="seal" mark="{{MARK: /logo.svg or none}}" headline="{{HEADLINE}}"
  subline="{{SUBLINE}}" micro="{{MICRO}}" serial="{{SERIAL}}" caption="{{CAPTION}}"></zen-foil>

scenes.title: Engraved globe
scenes.description: Engraved Earth turning under a holographic atmosphere; great-circle arcs carry your mark from an origin to every destination.

mark.description: Mark carried along the arcs and shown in the lockup.

partner.description: Optional partner mark: the lockup reads mark × partner.

layout.description: Globe position (auto: right on wide plates, top on narrow).

hubs.description: How many leading destinations carry the mark (the rest a spark).

micro.default: ZEN AI CO · GLOBAL NETWORK · AI LITERACY WORLDWIDE ·

scenes.example:
<zen-foil scene="globe" origin="-77.04, 38.91"
  points="-0.13,51.51; 13.40,52.52; 55.27,25.20; 139.69,35.69" mark="zen"
  headline="GLOBAL REACH" subline="AI PIONEER PROGRAM"></zen-foil>
scenes.template:
<zen-foil scene="globe" origin="{{LON,LAT}}" points="{{LON,LAT; LON,LAT}}"
  mark="{{MARK: /logo.svg or none}}" headline="{{HEADLINE}}" subline="{{SUBLINE}}"
  label="{{LABEL}}" micro="{{MICRO}}" stat="{{STAT}}"></zen-foil>

scenes.title: U.S. reach map
scenes.description: Engraved U.S. map; arcs spread from an origin under your seal, and each arrival issues the next credential serial.

origin.description: Where the wave starts: lon,lat (contiguous U.S.).

micro.default: THE FIRST YOUTH AI LITERACY PROGRAM IN UNITED STATES HISTORY · ZEN AI CO ·

scenes.example:
<zen-foil scene="usmap" origin="-77.04, 38.91" mark="zen" label="WASHINGTON, D.C."
  headline="ZEN AI CERTIFIED" serial="ZEN-AIL-2026-"></zen-foil>
scenes.template:
<zen-foil scene="usmap" origin="{{LON,LAT}}" points="{{LON,LAT; LON,LAT}}"
  mark="{{MARK: /logo.svg or none}}" label="{{LABEL}}" micro="{{MICRO}}"
  headline="{{HEADLINE}}" serial="{{SERIAL}}" caption="{{CAPTION}}"></zen-foil>

scenes.title: Guilloche banner
scenes.description: Interlaced guilloche waves across a wide band, a cartouche headline, end seals and edge microprint.

micro.default: ZEN AI CO · AI LITERACY · BUILT IN PUBLIC ·

scenes.example:
<zen-foil scene="banner" mark="zen" headline="AI PIONEER PROGRAM"
  subline="FIRST YOUTH AI LITERACY PROGRAM IN U.S. HISTORY"></zen-foil>
scenes.template:
<zen-foil scene="banner" mark="{{MARK: /logo.svg or none}}" headline="{{HEADLINE}}"
  subline="{{SUBLINE}}" micro="{{MICRO}}"></zen-foil>

scenes.title: Certificate
scenes.description: Guilloche-bordered credential: title, recipient, program, date, serial and a gold seal. Paper or holographic.

program.default: HAS COMPLETED THE AI LITERACY PROGRAM

serial.description: Credential serial (right foot). Use the real ID; the default is a placeholder.

issuer.description: Issuer, above the title and around the seal.

micro.default: ZEN AI CO · VERIFIED CREDENTIAL · AI LITERACY ·

scenes.example:
<zen-foil scene="certificate" mark="zen" recipient="RECIPIENT NAME"
  program="HAS COMPLETED THE AI PIONEER PROGRAM" serial="ZEN-AIL-2026-00000"
  issuer="ZEN AI CO"></zen-foil>
scenes.template:
<zen-foil scene="certificate" mark="{{MARK: /logo.svg or none}}"
  recipient="{{RECIPIENT}}" program="{{PROGRAM}}" serial="{{SERIAL}}"
  issuer="{{ISSUER}}" micro="{{MICRO}}"></zen-foil>

scenes.title: Metric plate
scenes.description: A decoding headline figure over an engraved, foil-lined chart of your series, with a live read head.

delta.description: Change or context line (accent). Use real figures only.

series.description: Values to chart (up to 24). The default is sample data — pass the real series.

mark.description: Issuer stamp, bottom right (none to omit).

scenes.example:
<zen-foil scene="metric" value="20,000+" label="ZEN WEEKLY SUBSCRIBERS"
  headline="ZEN WEEKLY"></zen-foil>
scenes.template:
<zen-foil scene="metric" value="{{VALUE}}" label="{{LABEL}}" delta="{{DELTA}}"
  headline="{{HEADLINE}}" micro="{{MICRO}}" series="{{SERIES}}"
  mark="{{MARK: /logo.svg or none}}"></zen-foil>

scenes.title: Agent network
scenes.description: Your mark as an orchestrating hub with labelled agents on an engraved orbit and packets streaming along the links.

nodes.default: RESEARCH, WRITER, ANALYST, DESIGNER, CODER, OPS

micro.default: ARSENAL.WORLD · AGENT + APP BUILDER · ZEN AI CO ·

scenes.example:
<zen-foil scene="network" nodes="RESEARCH, WRITER, ANALYST, DESIGNER, CODER, OPS"
  mark="zen" headline="ZEN ARSENAL" subline="AGENTS · ORCHESTRATED"></zen-foil>
scenes.template:
<zen-foil scene="network" nodes="RESEARCH, WRITER, ANALYST, DESIGNER, CODER, OPS"
  mark="{{MARK: /logo.svg or none}}" headline="{{HEADLINE}}" subline="{{SUBLINE}}"
  status="{{STATUS}}" micro="{{MICRO}}"></zen-foil>

scenes.title: Image engraving
scenes.description: Turns any image into a holographic banknote engraving; reveal mode adds a full-colour loupe that follows the pointer.
scenes.example:
<zen-foil scene="engrave" src="/images/photo.jpg" mode="reveal" headline="ZEN-GEN"
  subline="ENGRAVED EDITION"></zen-foil>
scenes.template:
<zen-foil scene="engrave" src="{{IMAGE URL}}" mark="{{MARK: /logo.svg or none}}"
  mode="reveal" headline="{{HEADLINE}}" subline="{{SUBLINE}}" micro="{{MICRO}}"></zen-foil>

scenes.title: Image stage
scenes.description: Gallery that mints each image in through its own engraved lines, over a blurred copy of itself, with sheen and microprint.

images.description: Image URLs (same-origin or CORS-enabled), shown in turn.

src.description: Show this one image (overrides images; set it to drive the stage yourself).

top.default: VISUAL ARCHIVE · ZEN AI CO · BUILT IN PUBLIC ·

bottom.default: ARCHIVE OF CAMPAIGNS, INTERFACES & GENERATIVE SYSTEMS ·

scenes.template:
<zen-foil scene="stage" images="{{IMAGE URLS, COMMA-SEPARATED}}" interval="6"
  top="{{TOP}}" bottom="{{BOTTOM}}"></zen-foil>

scenes.title: Crystal vault
scenes.description: Ray-traced glass cube with dispersion, your images (or video) printed on its faces, and engraved seals until they load.

images.description: Up to six image/video URLs, one per face (same-origin or CORS-enabled).

mark.description: Mark on the engraved seal faces.

frame.default: ZEN AI CO · VISUAL ARCHIVE · ORDO AB CHAO ·

scenes.template:
<zen-foil scene="vault" images="{{IMAGE URLS, COMMA-SEPARATED}}"
  mark="{{MARK: /logo.svg or none}}" frame="{{FRAME}}" ring="{{RING}}"></zen-foil>

scenes.title: Treasury field
scenes.description: Page-background field of floating cipher glyphs with parallax, sheen, watermark seals and decoding phrases.

variant.description: Light paper ground or dark ground.

density.description: Glyph density where no region says otherwise.

phrases.default: ORDO AB CHAO, AS ABOVE SO BELOW, SOLVE ET COAGULA, ANNUIT COEPTIS, NOVUS ORDO SECLORUM, LET THERE BE LIGHT, ZEN AI CO
phrases.description: Phrases that decode out of the noise (up to 8, 24 characters each).

scenes.title: STEMScore

scenes.title: ClinicalCipher

scenes.title: Prompt a Prototype

scenes.description: An engraved front page runs through the press, then fans out to subscribers.

scenes.title: InspireLens

scenes.title: GravityGrid

scenes.title: Animatic Pro

scenes.title: ChronosLife

scenes.title: DeadlineDash
scenes.description: Engraved chronograph countdown; momentum fills as time runs out.

scenes.description: Minted medallion with an engraved croissant over a map of pop-up pins.
